question: Should CodexBar support an explicit Claude-provider setting that lets one claude-swap account replace the ambient Claude presentation?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and backward-compatible, but it adds a new user-facing persisted policy whose acceptance is a product decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the opt-in setting
options.body: Merge the default-off setting so users with one valid claude-swap account can intentionally select that data source without changing existing setups.

options.title: Keep multi-account-only precedence
options.body: Decline the new setting and retain the established rule that only two or more claude-swap accounts replace ambient Claude cards.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in setting
recommendation.body: Merge the default-off setting so users with one valid claude-swap account can intentionally select that data source without changing existing setups.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged claude-swap adapter and its original account-presentation boundary.
